customMethods.name: save
customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("save() called")
	scheduleBlockInfo = dict(self.view.custom.values)
	recurrenceChangeType = self.view.custom.recurrence.changeType
	if scheduleBlockInfo['workOrderId']: scheduleBlockInfo['rruleStr'] = None	#Can't repeat a workorder run
	if scheduleBlockInfo['modeName'] == 'Production' and not scheduleBlockInfo['workOrderId'] and scheduleBlockInfo['itemId'] is None and scheduleBlockInfo['itemPath']:	#an item class picked from the breadcrumb
		system.perspective.sendMessage('schedulerToast', payload={'type': 'warning', 'message': 'Select an item, not an item class.'}, scope='page')
		return
	
	#Tool conflicts of the event as it will be saved (its tool picks included): confirm the soft ones, and the hard ones in 'warn' mode;
	#'block' mode refuses a hard one. toolingConfirmed is set by the confirm popup's OK (eventToolingConfirm).
	if self.view.custom.tooling.usesTooling and not self.view.custom.toolingConfirmed:
		hard, soft = self.toolingConflicts(scheduleBlockInfo, recurrenceChangeType)
		blockMode = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('configValue', system.kanoa.config.getConfig({'configName': 'toolingConflictMode'})) == 'block'
		if hard and blockMode:
			system.perspective.sendMessage('schedulerToast', payload={'type': 'error', 'message': 'Tool conflicts: %s' % '; '.join(hard)}, scope='page')
			return
		if hard or soft:
			messages = hard + soft
			shown = messages[:5] + (['and %d more' % (len(messages) - 5)] if len(messages) > 5 else [])
			text = 'This operation has tool warnings: %s. Schedule it anyway?' % '; '.join(shown)
			system.perspective.openPopup('toolingConfirmPopup', 'kanoa/core/templates/inputs/confirm', {'text': text, 'messageHandler': 'eventToolingConfirm'},
				title='Tool Warnings', modal=True, draggable=True)
			return
	self.view.custom.toolingConfirmed = False
	
	#toolingConfirmed: the tool warnings were checked (and confirmed) here, so the scheduler doesn't ask again
	eventInfo = {'scheduleBlockInfo': scheduleBlockInfo, 'changeType': recurrenceChangeType, 'start': self.view.custom.dates.start, 'end': self.view.custom.dates.end,
		'toolingConfirmed': True}
		
	if scheduleBlockInfo['scheduleBlockId'] is None: system.perspective.sendMessage("createEvent", eventInfo) #add event
	else: system.perspective.sendMessage("adjustEvent", eventInfo) #Update existing event
	
	system.perspective.closePopup('')
	
	return

customMethods.name: toolingConflicts
customMethods.script:
'''The hard and soft tool conflict messages of the event about to be saved, as getToolingConflicts sees its candidate.'''
	info = scheduleBlockInfo
	timezone = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('timeZone', system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetId': info['assetId']}))
	#The editor's dates are the asset's wall time; the database's are less the asset's offset, as the scheduler saves them
	start = system.date.parse(self.view.custom.dates.start)
	end = system.date.parse(self.view.custom.dates.end)
	startDate = system.date.addMinutes(start, -system.kanoa.date.getTimeZoneOffsetMins(timezone, start))
	endDate = system.date.addMinutes(end, -system.kanoa.date.getTimeZoneOffsetMins(timezone, end))
	rrule = None if changeType == 'This event' or info['workOrderId'] else info['rruleStr']
	candidate = {'scheduleBlockId': None if getattr(self.view.params, 'duplicate', None) else info['scheduleBlockId'], 'assetId': info['assetId'], 'itemId': info['itemId'],
		'workOrderId': info['workOrderId'], 'startDate': startDate, 'endDate': endDate, 'scheduledQty': info['scheduledQty'], 'rruleStr': rrule,
		'toolPicks': info.get('toolPicks')}
	hard, soft = [], []
	for c in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.tooling.getToolingConflicts({'candidate': candidate})):
		messages = hard if c['severity'] == 'hard' else soft if c['severity'] == 'soft' else None
		if messages is not None and c['message'] not in messages: messages.append(c['message'])
	return hard, soft

system.perspective.print('updateRecurringOption() msg rcvd with %s'%payload)
	self.view.custom.recurrence.state = 'update' if (payload['uuid'] or None) is not None else 'new'
	if (self.view.custom.values.rruleStr or None) is None and (payload['rruleStr'] or None) is not None: 
		self.view.custom.recurrence.changeType = 'All events'	#prevents recurrencePopup from being displayed when we are changing a non recurring event to a recurring event
		
	self.view.custom.values.rruleStr = payload['rruleStr']
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.display.currentTab")
	
	return

system.perspective.print('editRecurringEvent() msg rcvd with %s'%payload)	
	self.view.custom.recurrence.changeType = payload['selectedOption']
	self.save()
	
	return

system.perspective.print("itemSelected() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	
	if len(payload['selection']) > 0:
		v = payload['selection'][0]['value']
		if ('itemId' not in v) or v['itemId'] is None:	#an item class picked from the breadcrumb: no item, but the breadcrumb stays on the class; Save says to pick an item
			self.view.custom.values.itemId = None
			self.view.custom.values.itemName = None
			self.view.custom.values.itemPath = v['path'] if 'path' in v else None
			return
		self.view.custom.values.itemId = v['itemId']
		self.view.custom.values.itemName = v['itemName']
		self.view.custom.values.itemPath = v['path']
	else:
		self.view.custom.values.itemId = None
		self.view.custom.values.itemName = None
		self.view.custom.values.itemPath = None

	return

#A tool picked (or cleared) in the Tooling section: kept with the event and saved with it
	picks = [dict(p) for p in (self.view.custom.values.toolPicks or []) if p['itemAssetToolingId'] != payload['itemAssetToolingId']]
	picks.append({'itemAssetToolingId': payload['itemAssetToolingId'], 'toolingAssetId': payload['toolingAssetId']})
	self.view.custom.values.toolPicks = picks

#The tool warnings confirm popup: OK saves the event anyway
	if payload['userInput'] != 'OK': return
	self.view.custom.toolingConfirmed = True
	self.save()
